mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_project) AS "projects" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_revision WHERE status = 'READY') AS "readyRevisions" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_job WHERE status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING')) AS "activeJobs" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_job WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS "failedJobs7d"

SELECT p.project_id AS "projectId" , p.project_name AS "projectName" , p.description AS "description" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_revision x WHERE x.project_id = p.project_id) AS "revisionCount" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_job j WHERE j.project_id = p.project_id AND j.status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING')) AS "activeJobs" , lr.revision_id AS "latestRevisionId" , lr.revision_label AS "latestRevisionLabel" , lr.status AS "latestStatus" , to_char(lr.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "latestCreatedAt" , rr.revision_id AS "readyRevisionId" , rr.revision_label AS "readyRevisionLabel" , to_char(rr.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "readyCreatedAt" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = rr.revision_id) AS "files" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_method m WHERE m.revision_id = rr.revision_id) AS "methods" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_endpoint e WHERE e.revision_id = rr.revision_id) AS "endpoints" , mt.call_rate AS "callResolutionRate" , mt.parse_rate AS "parseSuccessRate" FROM analysis_project p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.revision_id, r.revision_label, r.status, r.created_at FROM analysis_revision r WHERE r.project_id = p.project_id ORDER BY r.revision_id DESC LIMIT 1) lr ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.revision_id, r.revision_label, r.created_at FROM analysis_revision r WHERE r.project_id = p.project_id AND r.status = 'READY' ORDER BY r.revision_id DESC LIMIT 1) rr ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MAX(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name = 'callResolutionRate') AS call_rate , MAX(m.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE m.metric_name = 'parseSuccessRate') AS parse_rate FROM analysis_metric m WHERE m.analysis_id = ( SELECT j.analysis_id FROM analysis_job j JOIN analysis_metric x ON x.analysis_id = j.analysis_id WHERE j.revision_id = rr.revision_id ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.analysis_id DESC LIMIT 1)) mt ON TRUE ORDER BY p.project_id

SELECT j.analysis_id AS "analysisId" , j.project_id AS "projectId" , j.revision_id AS "revisionId" , r.revision_label AS "revisionLabel" , j.status AS "status" , j.current_pass AS "currentPass" , j.total_files AS "totalFiles" , j.done_files AS "doneFiles" , LEFT(j.error_message, 500) AS "errorMessage" , to_char(j.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt" , to_char(j.ended_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "endedAt" , CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(j.ended_at, now()) - j.started_at)) AS BIGINT) AS "elapsedSeconds" FROM analysis_job j JOIN analysis_revision r ON r.revision_id = j.revision_id ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.analysis_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.collection AS "collection" , COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_seq) AS "documents" , COUNT(c.chunk_id) AS "chunks" , COUNT(e.content_hash) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'DONE') AS "embedded" , COUNT(e.content_hash) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'FAILED') AS "failed" , to_char(MAX(d.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "lastUploadedAt" FROM rag_document d LEFT JOIN rag_chunk c ON c.doc_seq = d.doc_seq LEFT JOIN rag_embedding e ON e.content_hash = c.content_hash AND e.model = #{model} WHERE GROUP BY d.collection ORDER BY d.collection NULLS LAST
